# od

Display file bytes in numeric or character form through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/od -An -tx1 input.bin

moonx cli/od -N 16 -c input.bin
```

Read files or stdin as a byte stream. Select address radix, output type, offsets and byte limits.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-A VALUE`, `--address-radix VALUE` | address base, or no addresses Default: `o`. |
| `-j VALUE`, `--skip-bytes VALUE` | skip N input bytes Default: `0`. |
| `-N VALUE`, `--read-bytes VALUE` | print at most N bytes |
| `-t VALUE`, `--format VALUE` | a, c, integers 1/2/4/8; floats 2/4/8/16; optional z |
| `-w VALUE`, `--width VALUE` | Set bytes per line; a bare option selects 32. Default: `16`. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

Use `--help` for the complete option list.

## Notes

Compatible with the MoonBit 2026-11-17 toolchain.

- Numeric interpretation follows a fixed Linux profile, not every host ABI. Locale-dependent character formatting is unsupported.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
